project.name: MPU6050 diagnostics
project.goal: Characterize identity, stationary behavior, drift, and motion response.

targets.label: MPU6050
limitations: Motion is observed at the sensor only.

setupChecklist: SDA on GPIO14 and SCL on GPIO13; pull-ups verified at 3.3 V; AD0 tied to ground for address 0x68.
interventionSafety: Power down before changing I²C wiring.

reference.description: No independent orientation reference is declared.
